SASBDB entry SASDPN6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDPN6/)

Publication: The preference signature of the SARS-CoV-2 Nucleocapsid NTD for its 5'-genomic RNA elements.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38882-y

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDPN6/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
